title: Iowa State vs UCF: 2nd Half Point Spread

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if UCF covers a -1.5 point spread against Iowa State during the 2nd half of the College Football game between Iowa State and UCF scheduled for November 20, 2026 at 6:00 PM ET, meaning UCF scores more than 1.5 points more than Iowa State during the 2nd half. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying counts only points scored by each team during the 2nd half, as documented by the official quarter-by-quarter scoring summary, and excludes overtime.
